title: fix(cli): os start answers an MCP initialize written at spawn — its compile and serve children no longer read stdin as the config path
body:
Fixes #24002

Clause-②: no

`os start` with the stdio MCP transport enabled now answers the `initialize` that an MCP client writes when it spawns the server, and it boots the configured app.

## What was wrong (measured on `origin/main` `b0fe9fad4`, built CLI through `bin/run.js`)

- **H1 holds** against the installed `@oclif/core` 5.1.2 (`lib/parser/parse.js`). `_args()` calls `tryStdin` for every positional that has no token, unless the arg sets `ignoreStdin`. `readStdin` opens a readline on `process.stdin` and collects lines for `OCLIF_STDIN_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 10 ms). On abort, `rl.close()` emits `close` synchronously, and that handler resolves with the lines collected so far. So a line already waiting in the pipe becomes the argument's value, and it is consumed.
- **H2 holds.** The `serve` argv was `binPath, 'serve', --ui|--no-ui, [--verbose], [--log-level]`, with no positional.
- **H3 holds.** `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact (default host)...` is printed by `serve.ts` (the `useArtifactFallback && !configExists` branch). `anchorServedApp` had resolved the `initialize` JSON as a config path that does not exist. The parent's banner had printed `Config: objectstack.config.ts` for the same boot.
- **A second consumer the card did not name.** On a first run (no `dist/objectstack.json`), `start` auto-compiles through `spawnSync(…, 'compile', '--output', …)` with stdio inherited and no positional. `compile`'s optional `config` positional reads the line first: `✗ Config file not found: …/{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":7,"method":"initialize",…}`, the compile fails, and `os start` exits 1.

The readings below come from one fixture: a host config (`defineStack` plus a marker plugin), a key minted through `serve --dev` and `POST /keys`, and `os start` run with `OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true` and that key. The `initialize` is written at spawn in every row.

| shape | before (`b0fe9fad4`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `os start`, no `dist/` | the compile child reads it: `Config file not found`, exit 1 | answered (`id` 7) in 8.8 s; `Loading objectstack.config.ts`; host plugin registered |
| `os start`, `dist/` present (the card's showcase shape) | the serve child reads it: `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact`; host plugin absent; no answer in 60 s | answered (`id` 7) in 6.6 s; `Loading objectstack.config.ts`; host plugin registered |
| control: `os serve objectstack.config.ts` | answered in 4.0 s, config loaded | unchanged |
| `os serve` with no positional | no answer in 60 s; `No objectstack.config.ts found` | unchanged: out of scope, see Acceptance notes |

## The fix (`packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts`)

1. **The compile spawn gets `stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit']`.** The compile reads no input, so it gets none, and every byte stays in the pipe for `serve`.
2. **The serve spawn passes `projectConfigPath` as the config positional.** A supplied positional skips `tryStdin`. `projectConfigPath` is `path.resolve(cwd, 'objectstack.config.ts')`, which is exactly what `serve`'s default `objectstack.config.ts` resolves to in the same cwd (`anchorServedApp` is `path.resolve(process.cwd(), configArg)`). It is also the path `start`'s own `Config:` row is judged by. Whether the config joins the boot is still the child's own `cwdConfigJoinsBoot` reading. No `serve` input surface changes. One visible difference: the `No default export found in …` refusal now names the absolute path when it is reached through `start`.

**Why not `ignoreStdin: true` on `serve`'s `config` (the card's alternative):**
- It changes `serve`'s input surface.
- It would defang the #7645 pin. `serve-mcp-stdio-answers.e2e.test.ts` deliberately passes no positional, so that `tryStdin` pauses stdin and the `resume()` in `MCPServerRuntime.start()` is exercised. With `ignoreStdin`, that pin stays green even with the `resume()` removed.

This route closes `os start`, both children. The bare `os serve` door is left as a measured finding.

**No feed of a config through stdin found:**
- Shell-piped config into `serve`, `start` or `compile`, regex `\|\s*(npx\s+)?(os|objectstack|run(-dev)?\.js)\s+(serve|start|compile)\b` together with a `(serve|compile)` stdin-redirect form: **0** hits.
- `stdin.write(` / `stdin.end(` under `packages/cli`: **5** hits. None of them is a config path: 3 are login prompts and 2 are JSON-RPC `initialize` writes.

**#7645 is not regressed.** `packages/mcp`'s `resume()` is untouched. The `start` → `serve` child now skips `tryStdin` entirely, so stdin is never paused on that path.

**Surface note.** The claim's file surface named the `spawnChild` argv (about `:486-500`). The measured fix also needs the compile `spawnSync` (about `:243`) in the same file, because it is the first stdin consumer in a fresh project. The pin's built-CLI spawns also join `check:cli-test-child-env`'s pinned built-entrypoint population, so `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` gains the file, with the `[#N] Joined the population deliberately` note that every earlier member carries. The gate's own self-test passes: 152 cases.

## Pin

`packages/cli/test/start-mcp-stdio-early-initialize.integration.test.ts` is in the `integration` tier: the `vitest-tiers.ts` predicate classifies it because it spawns `bin/run.js`. It runs one minting `serve --dev` boot, then one `os start` boot on a first-run host config, with the `initialize` written at spawn. It asserts:

1. A parseable JSON-RPC frame with the request's own `id` (24002), no `error`, a `protocolVersion` and a `serverInfo.name`.
2. The host config's plugin wrote its marker from `start()`, so the config was composed and not just its artifact.
3. `dist/objectstack.json` exists afterwards, as a positive control that the boot took the auto-compile leg.

The budget line is 20 s: 14.9 s, the slowest of three local runs on a shared container, x 1.25. There is no CI reading yet.

**Reverse verification.** Fix committed first. Each leg was run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` with a trap restore, and the CLI was rebuilt for every leg.

- **compile leg** (stdio back to `'inherit'`): the marker `'ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit'` is absent from `dist/`, and the pin goes **RED**: `initialize was never answered` / `os start exited 1 before answering`, with `Config file not found: …/{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":24002,…}` in the transcript. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`d874e9853`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and after the rebuild the marker is present again.
- **serve leg** (positional line deleted): the marker is absent, and the pin goes **RED**: `initialize was never answered` / `no answer within 120000 ms`, with `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact` in the transcript. Restored the same way.
- **Two serve attempts were voided, and nothing was measured in either.**
  - In the first, the replacement was a substring of the anchor. `ablation-replace` refused it (a replacement rise of 0) and restored the file, so the test never ran.
  - In the second, the dist preflight's tree reading could not see the source change, because the indentation differs between `src` and `dist`. It exited 3, so the test never ran.
  - The third attempt passed `--source-marker`.

## Local verification (head `ab0727fa5` unless noted)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 test/start-mcp-stdio-early-initialize.integration.test.ts`: 1 passed (14.85 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 309 files / 4591 tests passed, at `fd16e46f6`. The unit layer is unaffected by the later test-file and gate-script commits. The `integration` tier is declared to CI apart from the new file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --noEmit --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` includes the new pin.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed source files: exit 0, no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- The derived gate union (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) is running at `ab0727fa5`. Its verdicts and the `--ran` reconciliation go in the `os-dev-report` comment on #24002.
- An earlier run over the 65-command derivation at `0c194a89f` gave 62 exit 0.
  - `check:cli-test-child-env` exited 1 because of this pin. It was fixed in `ab0727fa5`, and the gate is now green: 12 built-CLI spawns, all keep their child out of `development`/`test`.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: packages outside the CLI closure are unbuilt in this worktree). **NOT MEASURED** locally; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` measures them on a full build.

## Acceptance notes

- **`os serve` with no positional loses an early `initialize` the same way.** Measured: no answer in 60 s, `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact` beside a config, host plugin absent. The `os serve objectstack.config.ts` control answers in 4 s. The fix shape is `ignoreStdin: true` on `serve`'s `config` positional, together with re-grounding the #7645 pin's premise (see above). Reported to the seat; not fixed here.
- **`os start`'s auto-compile writes its progress to stdout, which is the stdio transport's channel.** In the fixed first-run boot, 27 non-JSON lines (`◆ Compile`, `✓ Build complete`, `Artifact: …`) precede the `initialize` answer on stdout. A different class: stdout purity, the #7915 family, not stdin. Reported to the seat; the pin does not assert purity.
- `os dev`: its own `package` positional (default `all`) and its `serve` child also read a pending stdin line. `os dev` is not a stdio door (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json`: "Not `os dev`", because its banner owns stdout). Noted only.
